acquisition_limited.reason: JAMA top-tier 2015-present is hybrid/paywalled. (a) ~90% of PMC-linked JAMA articles are XML-only (no PMC PDF); (b) of the PMC-PDF subset, most are corrections/comments whose OpenAlex PMC link resolves to a DIFFERENT article (title mismatch on verification) - not the drawn DOI; (c) publisher PDFs (jamanetwork.com via Silverchair) are HTML-gated (articlepdf URL redirects to the fullarticle landing page, no downloadable PDF). Probed 60 of 120 drawn candidates: 11 had a PMC PDF, only 3 matched their drawn DOI, of which 2 are original research letters (ranks 27,30) and 1 a clinical review (rank 14, excluded). Documented per selection_protocol 1.4.1 step 4 and preflight exception_note.
